package_info.package_versions: unknown (affects sites where plugin is installed)
package_info.why_malicious: The plugin generates and displays fake ransomware notices on WordPress websites, attempting to extort website owners by tricking them into paying a ransom. It does not provide any legitimate functionality and is solely designed for fraudulent activity.

execution_context.trigger: runtime (when the plugin is activated or the site is loaded)
execution_context.file_location: WordPress plugin PHP file (exact filename not specified, but likely in wp-content/plugins/)

malicious_snippets.code_snippet:
Your Website Has Been Encrypted

To recover your files, send 0.1 bitcoin to the following address...
malicious_snippets.code_behavior: At runtime, the code generates and displays a fake ransomware notice as an HTML page, attempting to coerce the website owner into paying a ransom, with no actual file encryption taking place.

malice_analysis.why_suspicious: The code displays a ransom demand without performing any legitimate plugin function or actual encryption, which is a clear sign of a scam.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: A legitimate WordPress plugin should provide useful features or enhancements, not display extortion messages or attempt to defraud site owners.
malice_analysis.similar_legitimate_use: Legitimate plugins may display admin notices or maintenance messages, but never ransom demands.
key_indicators: Displays ransom demand to site owner
No actual encryption or file modification
HTML page generated by plugin rather than core WordPress

attack_chain.action: Attacker uploads and activates the bogus WordPress plugin on the target website.
attack_chain.leads_to: Fake ransomware notice is displayed to the website owner.

attack_chain.action: The plugin generates and displays an HTML page with a ransom demand, attempting to trick the owner into paying.
attack_chain.leads_to: Potential financial loss if the owner pays the ransom.

behavioral_signatures: WordPress plugin that displays ransom notices without encrypting files
Plugins generating HTML pages with bitcoin payment instructions
file_indicators: Presence of unfamiliar or recently added plugins in wp-content/plugins/
Plugin files containing hardcoded ransom messages or bitcoin addresses
network_indicators: No outbound network activity required for this scam (unless plugin attempts to phone home, not mentioned in report)
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor for new or unauthorized plugins in the WordPress installation, especially those that generate or display ransom messages. Scan plugin files for hardcoded bitcoin addresses or ransom-related keywords. Alert on any plugin that displays a ransom demand to administrators or site owners.
